_readme: LocalSell marketplace seed — edit this file, then run:  npm run seed
It WIPES every data table (users, stores, menus, orders, ledgers, riders,
customers, zones, config) and rebuilds the marketplace from this file.
Infra secrets on the Configuration row (Google Maps / Stripe / PayPal /
SMTP / Sentry keys) are read back and preserved — only the operational
fields below are reset.
Passwords here are the literal login passwords; they are hashed on seed.
images: a food's `image` is either a full https URL or a key into `images`.
addons: a food's `addons` entry is either a key into `addonGroups` or an
inline group object { title, min?, max, options: [{title, price}] }.
gstRegistrationType (vendor and/or store level, store overrides vendor):
REGULAR      — charges GST, `salesTax` on the store applies.
COMPOSITION  — GST-registered but legally cannot charge tax separately
(Sec 10 CGST Act) — set salesTax 0, it's ignored anyway.
UNREGISTERED — below the GST threshold, no GSTIN, no tax charged.
GSTINs below are fictional 15-char placeholders for demo data only.
UOM convention used throughout: weight (g/kg) and volume (ml/L) items use
`variations` for the different pack sizes; discrete items state the piece
count in the title/desc (e.g. '2 pcs', '4 Slice'); a dish served as one
portion (a burger, a dosa, a cup of coffee) needs no extra annotation.

configuration._whatsapp: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API for phone OTP. Non-secret IDs live here; the access token is NOT here — seed reads WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN from the env, else keeps whatever is on the Configuration row. All 8 templates are Meta-approved and the access token is set on the server, so this now defaults on for a fresh install; an already-deployed server keeps whatever the admin toggle is set to (see seed-from-config.ts).
configuration._email: SMTP for transactional email (partner-application alerts, etc). The password is NOT here — seed reads SMTP_PASSWORD from the env (localsell-api/.env locally, deploy/localsell.env on the server), else keeps whatever is already on the Configuration row.
configuration.termsAndConditions: LocalSell — Terms of Service. By placing an order you agree to pay the listed price plus applicable delivery fee and taxes. Orders are prepared and fulfilled by independent partner stores; LocalSell operates the marketplace and (where selected) the delivery. Cash-on-delivery orders must be paid in full to the delivery partner. Edit this text in Admin → Configuration.
configuration.privacyPolicy: LocalSell — Privacy Policy. We collect your name, phone, delivery address and order history to fulfil orders and provide support. We share the minimum necessary details with the partner store and the delivery partner assigned to your order. We do not sell your data. Edit this text in Admin → Configuration.

demoOrders.note: 0 customers in this seed, so there is no one to place a demo order under — demo orders are off. Add a customer above and flip enabled=true to get sample DELIVERED orders, ratings, commission and reports again. When it does run, every demo order is COD (see seed-from-config.ts).

images._note_new_grocery_images: spices/dryFruits/detergent/soap/pickle/bakery/iceCream added for the Deogarh Daily Mart expansion — each verified live (WebFetch) before use, one representative photo shared across every item in its category.
